justification: Standard: changes which council rules a house is shown, live in production. 100 area rules withheld (Parramatta late-night 64, Inner West named-lot LEP clauses 36) and 1,836 sign/commercial/industrial rules re-tagged from all project types to their own types through a new re-applied step. Not Critical: no new schema, no report or verdict wording, every write has a row-level backup and an undo. Not Minor: it changes served rules for every council.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions rows read live before every write: 64 Parramatta rows in sections 10.0 to 10.4, 36 Inner West rows in clauses 6.16-6.19 and 6.24-6.26, and 1,836 rows tagged only ALL with source config_all. Existing never_serve, not_covered and gate_rules mechanisms were reused, not rebuilt.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed one pipeline step could re-tag dev types. Wrong: gate_rules sets only listed gate columns and the council config re-applies ALL on every publish, so a plain database write would be undone. Fixed with a step called at the end of apply_gate_rules, matched by text fingerprint so new row ids keep the limit.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New: gate_rules_devtypes.py and dev_type_limits.json. Extended: hide_unmapped_area_rules.py gained --name and a no_chapter flag. Reused: never_serve text fingerprints, derive_precinct_keys entry point, may-apply export.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Prints to-change greater than 0 after the apply, meaning a publish re-set rows to all project types or a listed row was missed. It printed 1836 before the apply and 0 after it.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the apply the same command printed gate dev_type_limits to-change=1836 on production, so the check does detect untagged rows. After the apply a read-only rerun printed to-change=0, and the live for-property API returned the new signage tag for the three City of Sydney sign rules checked.

functions.name: apply_dev_type_limits
functions.input: A database cursor, an optional council slug, an apply flag, and an optional set of rule names
functions.output: A list of (id, column, before, after, rule) changes for the backup, and updates only when apply is true
functions.if_none: A row with no tags or no text is skipped; an empty chapter_key is matched as NULL

functions.name: entries
functions.input: The data file data/chapter_scope/dev_type_limits.json read from disk
functions.output: A tuple of reviewed entries, raising if the file is missing or a fingerprint count is wrong
functions.if_none: A missing file raises instead of silently limiting nothing

functions.name: where_for
functions.input: One selector dict with council, chapter_key, optional ids and an optional no_chapter flag
functions.output: A SQL where clause and its parameters, never an open-ended match
functions.if_none: A selector with no council or chapter_key aborts the run

queries.purpose: Select current rows tagged exactly ALL with source config_all for one council and chapter, to narrow listed ones
queries.where_clause: is_current AND source_council AND source_chapter_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM AND v2_dev_type_source = config_all
queries.if_zero: No rows change and the step prints to-change=0, which is the expected state after an apply

break_it.scenario: A council re-publish resets the narrowed rows back to all project types.
break_it.what_happens: Sign and shop rules reach every house again.
break_it.how: The step runs at the end of apply_gate_rules after every publish and matches by text fingerprint, so new row ids keep the limit.
break_it.repro: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --only dev_type_limits prints to-change=0 while the rows hold their limits.

break_it.scenario: A rule listed for narrowing was decided by the council config as declined, specific or text-derived.
break_it.what_happens: A decision made from the council's own words would be overwritten by a model label.
break_it.how: Only rows tagged exactly ALL with source config_all change; config_declined, specific and never-serve rows are skipped.
break_it.repro: tests/test_gate_rules_devtypes.py test_skips_anything_not_exactly_all passes, and fails when the check is removed (6 tests failed in the mutation run).

break_it.scenario: The wrong rows are withheld because a mistyped name matches nothing.
break_it.what_happens: The apply would silently hide no rules.
break_it.how: hide_unmapped_area_rules.py aborts unless --name matches exactly one entry.
break_it.repro: python scripts/hide_unmapped_area_rules.py --name typo prints an ABORT line.

post_merge.manual_verify: Rule list not yet checked in a browser for a user who has picked a project type; production data already verified by probes DQ-143 and DQ-148 at 0.
